quotes.quote: Our investments are paying off, the core business is strong, and we’re seeing velocity across the board

The average revenue per American user for our existing ‘family of apps’ users is several hundreds of dollars annually, and we expect Muse will reach an even higher level over time due to the amount of commerce that we already see taking place

Beyond large enterprises, we also see strong traction in deal wins and pipeline in the mid-market segment. These organizations understand that AI can be a force multiplier in scaling capabilities and redefining their competitive landscape
Through this engagement, we will scale engineering and technology operations to support ERP modernization, cloud-native platforms, and AI capabilities for our client. …
After decades of advancement in the computer industry, we are now at the beginnings of a new industrial revolution
To be part of this AI economy, you don’t want to just be consuming the AI; you want to be producing the AI … We could do all of that here in Europe, and in fact, we’ve already started.
When Chris found evidence that the universe was expanding at a rate no one expected, he and his team followed the data even when it went against the prevailing wisdom of the field. …
